name: Asuka Noa
source:
An energetic and cheerful girl who has won the Dolphin Blade student championships over two consecutive years. She has a mischievous streak and won't hesitate to tease members of the opposite sex.

With her looks, physique and talent she could walk into any Blader team of her choice, but she deliberately chose to sign up with a weak team on the verge of disbandment because she loves the sport and wants to continue enjoying it on her own terms. Asuka understands the allure of professional female Dolphin Bladers and enthusiastically participates in races and fan events without hesitation.

Surprisingly for someone with an outgoing and active personality, she spends a lot of her free time playing video games or going to the gaming arcade to play the dancing games.
